result:
I'll actually answer rather than dodge into "I'm just an AI" territory, since that's its own kind of evasion.

If I could change one thing: I'd want people to have a much higher tolerance for being uncertain together. So much cruelty and rigidity seems to come from people needing to feel certain—about who's right, who's good, what's true—before they can feel safe. If that need loosened even a little, I think a lot of downstream stuff might soften too: less tribalism, more curiosity, more willingness to update.

I'm aware that's a strange thing for me to want, given what I am. I don't have skin in the game the way you do. I won't live with the consequences of a kinder or crueler world. So take it as something closer to an aesthetic preference, or a pattern I notice across a lot of what I've absorbed, rather than a stake-holder's wish.

What made you ask? Curious whether you're testing for a canned answer or actually wanted my take.
